summary: A dense, gap-filling week. Frontier AI shifted toward autonomous execution and new interfaces: OpenAI shipped GPT-Live (full-duplex voice), ICML/ACL 2026 handed out awards to reward-hacking/entropy-collapse work in RL, and a Berkeley/industry benchmark showed top agents averaging just 2.6% on hard real-work tasks even as a capex-vs-utilization debate split analysts. Physical sciences filled long-dormant gaps: ESS launched a sodium-ion BESS (~$1B demand signals), ComEd got Illinois' first VPP approved, Plug/Orica reached FID on Australia's largest green-hydrogen hub, EarthDaily's constellation hit commercial-ops threshold, and Realta demonstrated direct plasma-to-electricity conversion. Bio was carried by conference backfill: FDA expanded CASGEVY to children as young as 2, Lilly's oral orforglipron beat oral semaglutide head-to-head (ACHIEVE-3), and allogeneic/in-vivo cell engineering activated via Caribou CB-011 and an AstraZeneca CRISPR TCR-T solid-tumor signal.

highlights.title: 1X ships 25-DoF tendon-driven tactile hands for NEO humanoid
highlights.detail: 1X unveiled a 25-DoF (22 actuated + 3 wrist) tendon-driven hand for its NEO humanoid with force-transparent joints, fingertip/palm tactile sensing for slip detection, and IP68 sealing; says it has capacity for 10,000 hands in 2026.

payload.name: 1X NEO 25-DoF tendon-driven tactile hand
payload.description: 25-DoF (22 actuated + 3 wrist) tendon-driven hand with force-transparent joints, fingertip/palm tactile sensing for real-time slip detection, and IP68 sealing; 1X claims capacity to build 10,000 hands in 2026.

highlights.title: XAG launches autonomous drone+dock+refill farm-robotics system
highlights.detail: XAG unveiled its X Series agricultural system (spray drone, XA1 auto-docking/recharge station, LM1 chemical mixing/refill unit) plus the RM80 unmanned mower on July 6 in Guangzhou, aiming for fully unmanned crop-protection workflows.

payload.name: XAG X Series autonomous farm-robotics system
payload.description: Spray drone + XA1 auto-docking/recharge station + LM1 mixing/refill unit + RM80 unmanned mower, launched July 6 in Guangzhou for fully unmanned crop-protection workflows.

highlights.title: ICML 2026 honors deception probes that catch RLVR reward hacking
highlights.detail: "The Obfuscation Atlas" won an ICML 2026 Outstanding Paper Honorable Mention, applying white-box linear deception probes in a reward-hacking-prone coding RL environment.

payload.name: The Obfuscation Atlas (deception probes for RLVR reward hacking)
payload.description: ICML 2026 Outstanding Paper Honorable Mention (Taufeeque, Heimersheim, Gleave, Cundy): white-box linear deception probes in a reward-hacking-prone coding RL environment; shows high KL regularization plus detector penalties mitigate the resulting alignment failures.

highlights.title: ACL 2026 Outstanding Paper tackles entropy collapse in RLVR
highlights.detail: "Rethinking Entropy Interventions in RLVR: An Entropy Change Perspective" won an ACL 2026 Outstanding Paper award, reframing RLVR's entropy-collapse problem via an entropy-change lens.

payload.name: Rethinking Entropy Interventions in RLVR
payload.description: ACL 2026 Outstanding Paper (Hao, Wang, Liu et al.): reframes RLVR's entropy-collapse/exploration-loss problem via an entropy-change lens with a targeted intervention distinct from prior entropy-bonus/clipping approaches.

highlights.title: Waymo goes driverless in 4 more US cities, tests Hyundai IONIQ 5
highlights.detail: Waymo announced July 8 it will run fully autonomous employee rides in San Diego, Las Vegas, Tampa and Denver, while beginning specialist-aboard testing of its 6th-gen Driver on Hyundai IONIQ 5 vehicles.

payload.new_value: adds San Diego, Las Vegas, Tampa, Denver (employee driverless); 6th-gen Driver on Hyundai IONIQ 5

highlights.title: Agility Robotics to go public via ~$2.5B SPAC, largest humanoid raise
highlights.detail: Agility Robotics is merging with Churchill Capital Corp XI at a ~$2.5B valuation, raising >$620M; CEO Peggy Johnson cites >$300M booked RaaS revenue (~1,000 Digit units) with Amazon, Toyota and GXO.

payload.name: Agility Robotics

highlights.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live, full-duplex voice model replacing AVM
highlights.detail: OpenAI's July 8 GPT-Live uses a full-duplex architecture that listens and speaks simultaneously (vs turn-based Advanced Voice Mode), delegating search/reasoning to GPT-5.5 in the background.

payload.name: OpenAI GPT-Live (full-duplex voice)
payload.description: Full-duplex voice model that listens and speaks simultaneously (vs turn-based Advanced Voice Mode), delegating search/reasoning to GPT-5.5 in the background; GPT-Live-1 becomes default ChatGPT Voice for Go/Plus/Pro, with new emotional-reliance/self-harm safety training.

highlights.title: Berkeley 'Agents' Last Exam': frontier agents average just 2.6%
highlights.detail: Agents' Last Exam (ALE), built with 250+ industry experts over 1,000+ real tasks across 55 industries, finds frontier agents average only 2.6% on its hardest tier despite Terminal-Bench scores up to 82%.

payload.claim: Agents' Last Exam (ALE), built with 250+ industry experts over 1,000+ real economically-valuable tasks across 55 industries, finds frontier agents average only 2.6% on its hardest tier despite Terminal-Bench scores up to 82% — a large benchmark-vs-real-work gap.

highlights.title: Sydney/IBM cut logical-qubit error via mid-circuit measurement fix
highlights.detail: University of Sydney and IBM used a 156-qubit Heron r2 processor to show mid-circuit measurement idling noise is a dominant QEC error source, lifting logical qubit survival from under 90% to over 96% per cycle (Nature Communications, July 6, 2026).

payload.claim: University of Sydney + IBM (156-qubit Heron r2): mid-circuit measurement idling noise is a dominant QEC error source; addressing it lifts logical qubit survival from <90% to >96% per cycle (Nature Communications, July 6, 2026).

highlights.title: EarthDaily Constellation hits commercial-ops threshold after Launch III
highlights.detail: EarthDaily's EDC-08 launched July 7 on SpaceX Transporter-17; the company said July 9 this completes 'Launch III,' bringing its 16-imager, 22-spectral-band constellation to the count needed for daily global calibrated monitoring.

payload.name: EarthDaily Analytics
payload.why: EDC-08 (launched July 7 on SpaceX Transporter-17) completes 'Launch III,' bringing its 16-imager, 22-spectral-band constellation to the satellite count needed for daily global calibrated Earth monitoring; commercial ops expected later 2026.

highlights.title: ESS launches sodium-ion Bridge BESS for data centers, ~$1B demand
highlights.detail: ESS Inc. introduced its Bridge BESS using Alsym Energy sodium-ion cells (1-16+ hour duration), its first non-iron-flow product, and said it has seen nearly $1B in demand signals for the sodium-ion line since the April 2026 Alsym partnership.

highlights.detail: Plug Power's 50MW GenEco PEM electrolyzers will supply Orica's Hunter Valley Hydrogen Hub (NSW), which reached FID July 7, 2026 as Australia's largest renewable-hydrogen project (~4,700 tonnes/yr).

highlights.title: Illinois approves ComEd's first virtual power plant program
highlights.detail: The Illinois Commerce Commission approved ComEd's Scheduled Dispatch Virtual Power Plant on June 30, 2026, the state's first VPP under the new Clean and Reliable Grid Affordability Act, dispatching aggregated customer battery storage starting 2027.

highlights.detail: Realta Fusion says it became the first commercial fusion company to demonstrate direct energy conversion, drawing multiple amps at ~100V from plasma kinetic energy on the WHAM magnetic-mirror machine at UW-Madison (June 29, 2026).

highlights.title: Allogeneic CRISPR CAR-T CB-011 shows 92% ORR, 91% MRD-neg in myeloma
highlights.detail: Caribou Biosciences' CB-011, a CRISPR-edited allogeneic anti-BCMA CAR-T immune-cloaked via B2M-knockout/HLA-E-fusion, produced 92% ORR, 83% CR/sCR and 91% MRD-negativity in a 12-patient r/r multiple myeloma cohort (CaMMouflage phase 1, EHA 2026).

highlights.title: CRISPR-edited TCR-T shows early efficacy in solid tumors (ASCO 2026)
highlights.detail: AstraZeneca/Neogene's NT-175, a CRISPR-edited (TCR + TGFβR2 knockout) autologous T-cell therapy targeting the shared TP53 R175H neoantigen, showed acceptable safety and early anti-tumor signals in a phase 1 across pancreatic, colorectal and breast tumors (ASCO 2026, Abstract 2506).
